entries.label: Button.is_enabled
entries.documentation: Current canonical enabled state.

entries.label: can_drop
entries.documentation: Read-only guard. Return allow/deny and optionally a user-facing reason.

entries.label: can_flip
entries.documentation: Read-only guard. Return allow/deny and optionally a user-facing reason.

entries.label: can_grab
entries.documentation: Read-only guard. Return allow/deny and optionally a user-facing reason.

entries.label: can_press
entries.documentation: Read-only guard. Return allow/deny and optionally a user-facing reason.

entries.label: card:flip
entries.documentation: Toggles face orientation; requires the entity to be flippable and a player guard when player-originated.

entries.label: card:set_face_up
entries.documentation: Queues a flip only when the requested orientation differs.

entries.label: Card.definition
entries.documentation: Reads immutable definition data.

entries.label: Card.definition_id
entries.signature: Card.definition_id: stable definition ID (serialized type unspecified)
entries.documentation: Identifies the authored card definition.

entries.label: Card.is_face_up
entries.documentation: Current canonical face orientation.

entries.label: container:add
entries.documentation: Atomically transfers an entity into this container. Default index is unspecified.

entries.label: container:contains
entries.documentation: Tests the single canonical source of membership.

entries.label: container:list
entries.documentation: Returns proxies in ascending stable EntityId order.

entries.label: container:move_to
entries.signature: container:move_to(entity: Entity, target: Container, index?: number)
entries.documentation: Atomically transfers an entity from this container to the target.

entries.label: container:remove
entries.documentation: Atomically removes an entity; destination/world encoding is unspecified.

entries.label: Container.count
entries.documentation: Number of contained entities.

entries.label: counter:add
entries.documentation: Adds and clamps to configured bounds.

entries.label: counter:reset
entries.documentation: Restores the canonical component default.

entries.label: counter:set
entries.documentation: Sets and clamps to configured bounds.

entries.label: counter:subtract
entries.documentation: Subtracts and clamps; represented as a negative add because Appendix C has no subtract action.

entries.label: Counter.value
entries.documentation: Current canonical value.

entries.label: data
entries.documentation: | Member | Parameters | Return | Determinism and status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | data | — | Not specified | surface only. SPEC 04.1 exposes packaged release data but defines no v1 lookup members. Data must come from the immutable packaged Release, never network or filesystem access. |

entries.label: deck:draw_to
entries.documentation: Draws canonical top card identity/identities to a container. Optionality/default for count is not stated by SPEC 04.

entries.label: deck:shuffle
entries.documentation: Reorders with canonical RNG; caller never supplies the result.

entries.label: Deck.count
entries.documentation: Number of cards currently in the deck. The last item is top in v1.

entries.label: die:roll
entries.documentation: Uses kernel RNG to choose a valid face; animation cannot choose the result.

entries.label: Die.faces
entries.signature: Die.faces: ordered table of canonical face values
entries.documentation: Authored valid faces. Their order participates in deterministic selection.

entries.label: Die.value
entries.documentation: Current canonical face value.

entries.label: game
entries.documentation: | Member | Parameters | Return | Determinism and status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | game | — | Not specified | surface only. SPEC 04.1 exposes the namespace but defines no v1 members. | | game:end(...) | Not specified | Not specified | SPEC 10.10 says this produces shared canonical results, but SPEC 04 does not include it in the v1 callable surface or define a registry action. It is therefore not stabilized here. |

entries.label: hand:add
entries.documentation: Transfers an entity into the hand. Default index is unspecified.

entries.label: hand:contains
entries.documentation: Tests canonical membership.

entries.label: hand:list
entries.documentation: Returns contained proxies in ascending stable EntityId order.

entries.label: hand:remove
entries.documentation: Removes an entity from the hand. The registry's world/no-container encoding is unspecified.

entries.label: Hand.count
entries.documentation: Number of contained entities visible through this proxy.

entries.label: on_container_add
entries.documentation: An entity is added to the bound container.

entries.label: on_container_remove
entries.documentation: An entity is removed from the bound container.

entries.label: on_drop
entries.documentation: The bound entity is successfully dropped.

entries.label: on_enter
entries.documentation: An entity enters the bound zone.

entries.label: on_flip
entries.documentation: The bound entity is successfully flipped.

entries.label: on_grab
entries.documentation: The bound entity is successfully grabbed.

entries.label: on_leave
entries.documentation: An entity leaves the bound zone.

entries.label: on_player_join
entries.documentation: A player lifecycle join.

entries.label: on_press
entries.documentation: The bound button is pressed.

entries.label: on_prompt
entries.documentation: Canonical prompt processing; exact context schema is unspecified.

entries.label: on_roll
entries.documentation: The bound die is rolled.

entries.label: on_start
entries.documentation: Canonical game initialization.

entries.label: Player.hand
entries.documentation: The player's semantic hand when configured.

entries.label: Player.id
entries.documentation: Stable logical participant identity; reconnect keeps the same ID.

entries.label: Player.name
entries.documentation: Player-facing name.

entries.label: Player.seat
entries.documentation: Canonical seat assignment. SPEC 04.9 demonstrates player.seat.id.

entries.label: players
entries.documentation: #### players:list()

entries.label: players:by_seat
entries.documentation: - Parameters: seat_id: SeatId. - Returns: the player assigned to that seat, or nil. - Determinism: canonical seat assignment lookup.

entries.label: players:count
entries.documentation: - Parameters: none. - Returns: the canonical player count as an integer. - Determinism: counts records in canonical players state.

entries.label: players:get
entries.documentation: - Parameters: id: PlayerId. - Returns: the matching Player proxy, or nil. - Determinism: stable identity lookup.

entries.label: players:list
entries.documentation: - Parameters: none. - Returns: an array of Player proxies. - Determinism: seated players use stable seat order; unseated participants follow in PlayerId order. This order is the basis for deterministic loops such as dealing.

entries.label: random
entries.documentation: All methods consume the versioned canonical PRNG stored in game state. They never use Lua entropy, Math.random, the browser, wall-clock time, or presentation randomness. A transaction that aborts discards its uncommitted RNG state along with its other gameplay mutations.

entries.label: random:choice
entries.documentation: - Parameters: list: table used as an ordered array. - Returns: one deterministic member, or nil for an empty list. - Determinism: selection depends on canonical RNG and the supplied array order. Never build the list from unordered table-key iteration.

entries.label: random:float
entries.documentation: - Parameters: none. - Returns: the canonical PRNG's deterministic finite value in [0,1). - Determinism: consumes canonical RNG; callers must not assume unstated numeric bounds.

entries.label: random:int
entries.documentation: - Parameters: min: number, max: number. - Returns: a deterministic integer in the inclusive [min,max] range. - Determinism: consumes canonical RNG in a replayable way.

entries.label: random:shuffle
entries.documentation: - Parameters: list: table used as an ordered array. - Returns: a new shuffled array; the input is unchanged. - Determinism: consumes canonical RNG. This list utility is distinct from Deck:shuffle(), which queues deck.shuffle and never accepts a caller-provided resulting order.

entries.label: refs
entries.documentation: refs.<name> resolves an editor-defined entity reference by stable identity. Renaming the entity or changing its display name does not break the reference.

entries.label: scene
entries.documentation: #### scene:get(id)

entries.label: scene:find
entries.documentation: - Parameters: name: string — authored entity name. - Returns: the first matching entity proxy in ascending EntityId order, or nil. - Determinism: duplicate names resolve by ascending stable EntityId. Prefer refs or stable IDs.

entries.label: scene:get
entries.documentation: - Parameters: id: EntityId — stable entity identity. - Returns: the matching semantic entity proxy, or nil for a missing ID. - Determinism: identity lookup is canonical; it must not consult renderer objects.

entries.label: scene:query
entries.documentation: - Parameters: filter: table; SPEC 04 shows { tags = { "enemy", "unit" } } and defines no other keys. - Returns: an array of matching proxies. - Determinism: results use ascending stable EntityId order.

entries.label: scores
entries.documentation: Deterministic finite score convenience state stored under canonical state; ties use stable player ordering.

entries.label: scores:add
entries.documentation: Adds to and returns a subject's score.

entries.label: scores:get
entries.documentation: Returns a subject's score, defaulting to zero.

entries.label: scores:leader
entries.documentation: Returns the highest-scoring player; stable player order breaks ties.

entries.label: scores:set
entries.documentation: Sets and returns a subject's score.

entries.label: settings
entries.documentation: settings is the read-only canonical room-start configuration. Scripts may branch on it, but cannot change it. Values are canonical-compatible and identical for healthy simulations processing the same game.

entries.label: snap_point:attach
entries.documentation: Attaches if capacity and compatibility allow.

entries.label: SnapPoint.entities
entries.signature: SnapPoint.entities: ordered table of entity proxies
entries.documentation: Entities currently attached in ascending stable EntityId order.

entries.label: SnapPoint.is_occupied
entries.documentation: Whether canonical capacity is occupied.

entries.label: state
entries.documentation: Persistent canonical script data. See Persistent state. Reads return the reconstructed canonical value; writes are committed only if the surrounding top-level action succeeds.

entries.label: text:get
entries.documentation: Reads the canonical text value.

entries.label: text:set
entries.documentation: Sets a bounded canonical string; the v1 size limit is unspecified.

entries.label: timer
entries.documentation: #### timer:after(delay, callback_name)

entries.label: timer:after
entries.documentation: - Parameters: delay: number, shown in seconds by timer:after(5, ...); callback_name: string. - Returns: a timer ID is implied by timer:cancel(timer_id), but its exact return contract is not stated. - Determinism: schedules a named one-shot callback. Room service later contributes system.timer_fire, which fires the timer exactly once in canonical order.

entries.label: timer:cancel
entries.documentation: - Parameters: timer_id: TimerId. - Returns: nil. - Determinism: queues timer.cancel; cancellation is canonical and a later system.timer_fire rejects.

entries.label: turns
entries.documentation: Deterministic turn convenience state stored under canonical state; this is Lua stdlib v1, not a kernel primitive.

entries.label: turns:current
entries.documentation: Returns the current player or nil when stopped.

entries.label: turns:index
entries.documentation: Returns the current one-based turn index, or zero before start.

entries.label: turns:is_current
entries.documentation: Tests a player proxy or PlayerId against the current turn.

entries.label: turns:next
entries.documentation: Advances cyclically and returns the next player.

entries.label: turns:start
entries.documentation: Starts the stable seat-order/player-ID order, optionally at a supplied player, and returns the current player.

entries.label: turns:stop
entries.documentation: Stops turn progression without discarding the stored order.

entries.label: ui
entries.documentation: The UI namespace creates structured canonical prompts, not arbitrary DOM or custom UI. A player answers through prompt.respond; the response becomes part of the ordered action stream and must target that player and satisfy the stored schema.

entries.label: ui:confirm
entries.documentation: - Parameters: player: Player; schema: { id: string, title: string, ... }. - Returns: the canonical prompt ID. - Behavior: creates a confirmation prompt whose response is boolean.

entries.label: ui:number_prompt
entries.documentation: - Parameters: player: Player; schema: { id: string, min: number, max: number, step: number, default: number, ... }. - Returns: the canonical prompt ID. - Behavior: creates a numeric prompt with inclusive endpoints and exact min + n step validation.

entries.label: ui:prompt
entries.documentation: - Parameters: player: Player; schema: { id: string, title: string, choices: table, ... }. - Returns: the canonical prompt ID. - Behavior: creates a choice prompt. Beyond the shown id, title, and choices, the schema is not defined in SPEC 04.

entries.label: zone:contains
entries.documentation: Tests canonical zone membership. Membership is recomputed on semantic placement transitions, not frame physics.

entries.label: Zone.entities
entries.signature: Zone.entities: ordered table of entity proxies
entries.documentation: Current members in ascending stable EntityId order.
